integrity: Exact count follows from fiberwise linear algebra and root-of-unity enumeration; finite checks are supplementary and do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite fields whose characteristic does not divide 6(2m+1); no claim for bad characteristic or GIT quotients. Priority may be affected by unindexed arithmetic-representation literature.
title: Finite-field zeta functions of Borel representation fourfolds of parafree groups
